svg.title: UML class diagram of GeoMesh.py
svg.text: Runs inside SALOME's embedded Python. Builds the room geometry with GEOM, names every face group (the future OpenFOAM patches) and meshes it with SMESH / NETGEN.
every GEOM call goes through it
cut the objects out, then name faces
+ add_box_volume(x, z, theta, R_Tubo, R_Vol, H_Tubo, H_Vol, Filete,
+ add_box_cilinder(x, z, R_Tubo, R_Vol, H_Tubo, H_Vol, Filete, name,
+ add_cilinder(salome_env, x, z, R_Tubo, R_Ponta, H_Tubo, H_Ponta,
creates a default Salome_Env if none
• the outlet face of each dip → inlet_<name>
• small ceiling / floor faces (the openings) → outlet
after every change, or SALOME keeps
